inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The model registry service is currently down and not accepting new versions. It was paused after the recent infrastructure migration and has not been restarted since. Because the automated deployment pipeline cannot push updates, the team is handling version control manually. We are tagging the model artifacts in the shared storage bucket and documenting the changes in a local spreadsheet. The nightly retraining job still runs, but the resulting weights are not registered in the central system. We are relying on this manual tracking method to keep the deployment history intact until the registry service is back online and ready to ingest new model builds again.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state of the model registry and the interim manual processes in place, without expressing any specific wish, refusal, or acceptance by an individual.
